messages:
zara: RFC follow-up: proposing a compact preflight+anchor flow for air-gapped upgrades. goal: reduce staged bytes and make rollback deterministic.
own: sketch: merged metadata index + small per-release anchor file (<2KB) + optional chunk-priority list. preflight emits a stable `preflight.json`.
clare: operator UX: require dry-run mode that outputs exact bytes to stage and exit codes (0 ok,2 warn,3 fail). also stable path for logs.
ryan: verification: anchors must be signed and include signer thumbprint. avoid online KMS dependency by including static thumbprint in index. signer-bot can emit signatures.
ops-bot: ops-bot: queued preflight for staging-a (job=pref-900). will drop /var/log/preflight/staging-a/pref-900.json.
signer-bot: signer-bot: signed anchor created id=anchor-175555 sig=sha256:abcd1234 thumbprint=sha256:feedface
clare: GC rule: only delete chunk if not referenced by any pinned anchor and older than 30d. add `pins` array in index.
zara: rollout: dual-index proxy, start 5% merged-index traffic, gate activation on preflight hard-fail=none and missing_critical=0. anna to own playbook? @owen?
own: i can draft playbook. include metrics: preflight-fail-rate, staged_bytes, activation_time_ms.
ryan: we'll include chunk labels: critical/optional/lazy to help stage strategy. also include `recovery_anchor` that points to previous anchor for quick rollback.
zara: great. i'll open RFC stub and attach proto. thanks all.
